repos_data.description: Official CLI, MCP server and Claude Code plugin for ClipUGC. Make UGC videos for mobile apps with an AI influencer who keeps the same face, with your app's screen recording inside. Hosted MCP: clipugc.com/mcp
Connect any local MCP client to your Asyntai account. Bridges stdio to the hosted Asyntai MCP server and handles the OAuth sign-in.
